question: Who has been conferred the first ever 'Udyog Ratna' award instituted by the Maharashtra government in August 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ratan Tata**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ratan Tata** has been conferred the first ever '**Udyog Ratna**' award instituted by the **Maharashtra government in August 2023**.
 
• The 'Udyog Ratna' award is a prestigious recognition by the state government to honor individuals for their significant **contributions to industry and economy**.
 
• Ratan Tata is the Chairman Emeritus of Tata Sons and has been instrumental in the growth and expansion of the **Tata Group **globally.
 
• He is known for his visionary leadership and philanthropic efforts, making him a respected figure in the business community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ratan Tata** has received several national and international honors, including the **Padma Vibhushan and Padma Bhushan**, which are among India's highest civilian awards.
 
• Under his leadership, the Tata Group achieved significant milestones, including the **acquisition of global brands like Jaguar Land Rover and Corus Steel**.
 
• Ratan Tata's philanthropic initiatives through the Tata Trusts have made substantial contributions to education, healthcare, and rural development in India.
 
• He continues to be an influential figure in various sectors and serves on the boards of numerous organizations worldwide.
